summary: Revised UI/UX architecture plan incorporating all 5 structural fixes: (1) explicit mutually-exclusive Tab routing for Chat/Artifacts/Telemetry, (2) moving Daemon Status from Sidebar Nav to persistent Header chrome, (3) adding an explicit WebSocket/IPC -> State Store & Event Buffer layer, (4) defining ZeroHero and Stepper in-plan, and (5) separating ModelPicker and System Actions into distinct header zones.
